scope: Zen production connectors, isolated headless fixture, current public free catalog; not an all-green release gate
limitations: The first DeepSeek batch stopped after saving three cases: legacy Windows console could not encode a Unicode reply. The stdout fix and focused regression are retained.
All eight non-region-blocked models passed SSE two-turn recall initially; JSON probes were rejected. Beam and Crouton returned RegionError and their remaining conversation probes were not run.
Later SSE requests also returned FreeUsageLimitError, including the final DeepSeek control. This does not identify private quota versus eligibility/rate policy.
Reasoning acceptance proves only a nonempty response, not the internal reasoning budget.
Missing usage remains unknown; no zero-token or zero-consumption inference is made.
